title: Deduplicate interest_tags / fear_tags / dislike_tags into persona.personality as single source of truth

sections.what: Remove the duplicated `player.interest_tags`, `player.fear_tags`, and `player.dislike_tags` fields and make `node.properties.persona.personality` (`interests`, `fears`, `dislikes`, `likes`, `kinks`, `turn_ons`, `turn_offs`, `traumas`) the single source of truth across engine, serialization, prompts, and UI.
sections.why: Characters currently store and edit interests, fears, and dislikes in two places (`persona.personality.*` on the character node and `interest_tags`/`fear_tags`/`dislike_tags` on Player/node.properties). Editing in the Bio tab drifts out of sync with the Persona tab, `dislike_tags` is not projected during persona compile, and `to_scenario_dict()`/serialization carries redundant copies.
sections.how:
1. Add a single read helper (e.g. `get_persona_tags(world_graph, char_name, field)` in `engine/character_appearance.py` or `engine/character_record.py`) that reads directly from `node.properties.persona.personality`.
2. Migrate all backend readers (`engine/fear.py`, `engine/background_social.py`, `routes/action_handlers.py` `find`, `routes/memories.py`, `routes/player_ops.py`) to read from `persona.personality` instead of `player.interest_tags` / `fear_tags` / `dislike_tags`.
3. In `engine/serialization.py`, add one-time load migration that folds any legacy `interest_tags` / `fear_tags` / `dislike_tags` into `node.properties.persona.personality` (`interests` / `fears` / `dislikes`) and stop persisting the legacy fields in `to_scenario_dict()` and `to_dict()`.
4. Remove `interest_tags`, `fear_tags`, `dislike_tags` from `Player.__init__` and `routes/player_ops.py` persona-compile projection.
5. Update `static/js/inspector/agent-view.ts` (Bio tab) so its tag editors read/write directly to `node.properties.persona.personality` instead of `player.interest_tags` / `fear_tags`.
6. Simplify `static/js/agent/prompt-builder/room-context.ts` `buildAttention()` to read solely from `node.properties.persona.personality`.
sections.verify:
1. Load a legacy scenario with `interest_tags`/`fear_tags` on players and verify they migrate cleanly into `persona.personality` on load.
2. Edit interests/fears/dislikes in the Bio tab and confirm the Persona tab immediately reflects the same values (and vice versa).
3. Run `find`, fear reactions, and `buildRoomContext()` attention sorting and verify all read from `persona.personality`.
4. Run `pytest tests/test_serialization.py tests/test_find_command.py tests/test_fear.py`.

acceptance.text: Single source of truth: `node.properties.persona.personality` owns `interests`, `fears`, `dislikes` (alongside `likes`, `kinks`, `turn_ons`, `turn_offs`, `traumas`); `player.interest_tags`, `player.fear_tags`, `player.dislike_tags` are removed.
Legacy scenarios with `interest_tags`/`fear_tags`/`dislike_tags` auto-migrate into `persona.personality` on load and no longer serialize the legacy keys.
Character Inspector Bio tab tag controls point directly at `persona.personality` instead of `player.*_tags`.
